subject: Renewal: premium SLA + capacity uplift proposal and kickoff timeline
messages:
From: Claire Park <claire.park@novusai.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novusai.com>
Date: 2027-04-22 09:14 -07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion — premium SLA + capacity uplift

Hi Michael,

We’re coming up on renewal for our enterprise contract (June 30). Usage growth forecasts show a 3x token volume increase next 12 months; the product team is asking for a predictable latency envelope and faster response SLA for critical inference requests.

Specifically, can you share:
- An option to move to Premium SLA with a 99.9% latency SLO (p95 < 120ms) for our production routes.
- A committed capacity uplift (reserved GPUs) for burst windows and a pricing impact.
- Any ramp/onboarding support and estimated timeline for an upgrade.

We’d like a short proposal by next week to discuss with Procurement.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Park
Head of Product Ops — NovusAI

Attachments: none
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@novusai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-23 11:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — premium SLA + capacity uplift

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear ask. We can put together a concise package that addresses: premium SLA, committed capacity, onboarding, and a mutual action plan. High level:

- Premium SLA: 99.9% availability with latency banding targets. We propose a p95 target of 110ms for pinned production routes under the committed capacity profile; fallback variants will preserve availability if capacity is exceeded.
- Capacity uplift: two options — (A) +50% reserved capacity (lower per-token uplift) or (B) +2x reserved capacity for peak windows (higher commitment, deeper discount).
- Onboarding: two-week technical onramp with a dedicated success engineer + one production run of load testing.

I attached a draft SLO proposal (redwood_slo_proposal_v2.pdf) and a mutual action plan spreadsheet. Can we book 30 minutes on Thu 4/29 to walk the options with your infra and procurement teams?

Best,
Michael Grant
Director, Account Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_slo_proposal_v2.pdf, mutual_action_plan_novusai.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Claire Park <claire.park@novusai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-24 08:47 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — premium SLA + capacity uplift

Claire, quick technical notes from the serving/runtime side: 

- The 110ms p95 is achievable for your normal sequence lengths (avg 64 tokens) if we pin model variants to dedicated GPU pool and use moderate batching (we’ll preserve tail latency with priority routing).
- For the +2x reserved capacity option we recommend enabling prefix/KV caching on a subset of routes to reduce egress by ~20% during bursts.
- Optional: lightweight quantization on non-critical routes to cut cost without affecting quality.

Happy to jump on the call and map the traffic shapes you expect during peak.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Claire Park <claire.park@novusai.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novusai.com>
Date: 2027-04-26 10:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — premium SLA + capacity uplift

Thanks Michael and Ben — the proposal looks promising. Procurement looped me in and asked for:
- Finalized per-month pricing for both capacity options, including any onboarding credits or term discounts.
- Standard SOC2 evidence and a short note on data residency (we must keep EU customer data within EU regions).
- A clean agreement/DocuSign link we can circulate to legal.

Samir (cc) — can you confirm timeline constraints on your side? We need to complete commercial signoff by May 15 to avoid any service disruption.

Claire
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@novusai.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novusai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29 09:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — premium SLA + capacity uplift

Samir / Claire — attached is the updated SLO proposal and pricing sheet with two options and term-based discounts (redwood_slo_proposal_v2.pdf). Highlights:

- Option A (50% reserved capacity): +12% per-month list uplift; includes 1-week onboarding credit and 30 days of elevated monitoring.
- Option B (2x reserved capacity): +32% per-month list uplift; includes two-week onboarding, a dedicated success engineer for 60 days, and a 3% annual term discount if you sign a 12-month extension.

We also included a short SOC2 statement and confirmation we can pin EU routes to EU regions for data residency. I’ve created a DocuSign envelope for the SLA addendum (link below) — we can route a signature path: Claire -> Samir -> Redwood Legal.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/ABC12345

Proposed kickoff for onramp: week of May 9 if signed by May 15. If Procurement needs a SOW-level runbook, Ben can produce a one-page technical runbook by EOD May 3.

On the call earlier, Ben suggested a short canary window; we’ll coordinate exact traffic split once signed.

Best,
Michael
Attachments: redwood_slo_proposal_v2.pdf
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novusai.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Claire Park <claire.park@novusai.com>
Date: 2027-04-30 15:42 -07:00
Subject: Signed SLA addendum and kickoff

Michael / Claire — we reviewed with Legal and have executed the SLA addendum via DocuSign (see attached docsign_novusai_sla_agreement.pdf). Thank you for moving quickly.

Next steps from Procurement:
- Confirm invoice schedule for the chosen Option B (2x reserved capacity) and send initial invoice to billing@novusai.com.
- Confirm May 10 PST as kickoff for technical onramp (Ben: please confirm team availability).

Claire — I’ll follow up with an internal calendar invitation.

Samir Patel
Head of Procurement — NovusAI
Attachments: docsign_novusai_sla_agreement.pdf
